newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago launches online brokerage.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago launches online brokerage.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Investment Services Inc said Tuesday it launched FCNIS Online, its online brokerage services on the Internet.

"Customers use Internet access to initiate trades, track their investments and keep tabs on the market from their personal computer at home or the office," said Richard Hawes, president of FCNIS, a brokerage subsidiary of First Chicago NBD Corp.

Customers will receive a financial incentive to try FCNIS Online, he said in a statement. Stock and option trades placed through FCNIS Online receive a 25 percent discount from the firm's commission schedule.
To ensure security, FCNIS Online said investors must use an Internet browser with a 128-bit encryption for messages and orders.
The service can be found at www.fcnis.com on the Internet.
FCNIS has nearly 200,000 investment customers in the United States.
